short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 49 recent saved-signal files and 85 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Most Detroit landlords have no legal right to collect rent, housing attorneys say - Detroit... and Anchor image material 2, plus 7 more. A source image from metrotimes.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from Most Detroit landlords have no legal right to collect rent, housing attorneys say - Detroit....: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-05. Use architectural section with architectural section; make Reserve a large pale overcast upper field, borrowing the source photo's blank gray sky as severe negative space rather than filling it with decoration. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against torn left brick island, arched green window aperture, and central vertical masonry scar.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
